description: MUI and Tailwind breakpoint mismatch (MUI sm=600px, md=900px vs Tailwind sm=640px, md=768px). Mixing MUI Grid/Hidden with Tailwind classes causes layout snapping issues on 600-640px and 768-900px viewports.
evidence: defaultTheme.ts uses MUI defaults without overriding breakpoints, while tailwind.config.js uses Tailwind v4 defaults.
recommendation: Synchronize MUI breakpoints with Tailwind breakpoints (640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536) in defaultTheme.ts.
